Maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for parallel multi-step tool calling for next quarter. Customers want multiple calls in one turn, control over ordering, explicit per-call timeouts/retries, and clear billing semantics.
Ajay (Eng): Constraints: GPU throughput, KV cache boundaries, and routing. Fanout multiplies token load and affects batching.
Sam (ML): Also need to decide cache sharing: do parallel calls share KV cache or run isolated contexts? That changes memory & correctness tradeoffs.
Leo (Product): Launch criteria draft: (1) stable API for batched/invoked calls, (2) idempotent retry contract, (3) documented latency SLOs + fallback behavior, (4) per-call observability and cost breakdown.
Maria (PM): Prioritization question: MVP = "best-effort parallel" (unordered, faster) or "ordered atomic flow" (strict ordering, potentially higher latency/cost)? Thoughts?
Ajay (Eng): Recommend MVP = best-effort parallel + explicit ordering flag for clients. Easier to implement and covers most customer cases.
Sam (ML): For retries: require client-supplied idempotency_token per call. Example payload for discussion:
```json
{
  "calls": [
    {"tool": "search", "idempotency_token": "abc123", "timeout_ms": 1200},
    {"tool": "summarize", "depends_on": [0], "timeout_ms": 2000}
  ],
  "mode": "parallel_best_effort"
}
```
Leo (Product): Observability: per-call traces, request_id mapping, and token-level cost attribution. Need explicit docs on who is billed for retries and partial failures. My proposal: bill successful token consumption; surface retry counts in billing UI.
Maria (PM): Risk register: (a) billing surprises, (b) latency SLA regressions for sync APIs, (c) rollout complexity. Mitigations: default parallel opt-out, conservative per-call timeouts, and per-call quota controls.
deploy-bot: RFC review meeting scheduled at 1905002800 — please bring customer examples, cost models, and a short demo.
Ajay (Eng): Action items: open spec PR with API proto + prototype supporting unordered parallel + per-call timeouts/retries. Rough estimate: 3 sprints to MVP + canary.
Leo (Product): Also add acceptance criteria: end-to-end demo with a real customer flow, billing breakdown in console, and SLO docs.
Maria (PM): Quick vote — thumbs if you agree to the MVP scope and gating above :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
Leo (Product): +1
Sam (ML): +1
Ajay (Eng): +1
Maria (PM): Thanks — I'll file the formal proposal and link to roadmap; will add the risk/mitigation matrix.
